definition: the thick soft part of a bed you lie on
description: In a bright mattress showroom with rows of beds along a window wall, a young woman in colourful sportswear sits on the edge of a bare mattress and pulls a pained face, then lies back on it laughing. She stands up and talks to the camera, and finally throws herself backwards onto a large mattress, arms and legs spread wide, staring up at the ceiling.

de.answer: Sie liegt quer über einer riesigen Matratze.
phrases: sich quer über die Matratze ausstrecken
de.question: Wo liegt die Frau?

es.answer: Está tumbada a lo ancho de un colchón enorme.
phrases: tumbarse a lo ancho del colchón
es.question: ¿Dónde está tumbada la mujer?

fr.answer: Elle est allongée en travers d'un immense matelas.
